sources.title: live-portrait: Image-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview live-portrait is an image-to-video animation model that brings still images to life by transferring motion from a driving video. Built by okaris, this model implements efficient portrait animation through stitching and retargeting mechanisms that preserve identity while enabling realistic motion transfer.
